bio: Giovanni was baptized Domenico Giovanni on 5 August 1759, son of Francesco Colosimo (son of the late Antonio) and Giulia Putaro ([R4-S1]). He married Teresa Cicco on 10 November 1777 ([R4-S2]). He died on 11 February 1833 and was buried the next day as Teresa's widower ([R4-S3], [R4-S4]). The civil death act names his mother as Francesca Manfredi, but his marriage and baptism both say Giulia Putaro.
